---
title: "Randomized study on PSTD"
params:
  lang: "en"
---

```{r, include=FALSE}
library(exams)
library(mathml)
library(htmltools)
library(mistakes)

hook(s2_pool, subscript(s^2L, pool))
hook(mu_A, subscript(mean(X), "A"))
hook(mu_B, subscript(mean(X), "B"))
hook(n_A, subscript(n, "A"))
hook(n_B, subscript(n, "B"))
hook(s_A, subscript(s, "A"))
hook(s_B, subscript(s, "B"))

task <- "tgroups5"
plfile <- file.path("rexams", sprintf("%s.pl", task))
rolog::consult(system.file(plfile, package="mistakes"))


## DATA GENERATION
repeat
{
  n_A <- sample(20:50, 1)
  n_B <- n_A + sample(-10:10, 1)

  mu_A <- round(runif(1, 25, 45), 1)
  mu_B <- round(runif(1, 20, 40), 1)

  s_A <- round(runif(1, 5, 12), 1)
  s_B <- round(runif(1, 5, 12), 1)

  if(n_A == n_B)
    next

  s2_pool <- round(((n_A - 1) * s_A^2 + (n_B - 1) * s_B^2) / (n_A + n_B - 2), 1)

  tratio <- (mu_A - mu_B) / sqrt(s2_pool * (1/n_A + 1/n_B))
 
  if(abs(tratio) < 0.5 || abs(tratio) > 1.5)
    next
  
  df <- n_A + n_B - 2
  pvalue <- 2 * pt(tratio, df = df, lower.tail = TRUE)

  if(pvalue <= 0.05 || pvalue >= 0.50)
    next

  Q <- quote(search(tgroups5, tgroups(n_A, mu_A, n_B, mu_B, s2_pool), .S, .R, .P, .E))
  S <- findall(Q, options = list(preproc = as.rolog), env = environment())

  if(problems(S))
    next

  break
}

tab <- data.frame(
  "Therapy A" = c(sprintf("%.0f", n_A), sprintf("%.1f", mu_A), sprintf("%.1f", s_A)), 
  "Therapy B" = c(sprintf("%.0f", n_B), sprintf("%.1f", mu_B), sprintf("%.1f", s_B)),
  check.names = FALSE
)

row.names(tab) <- c("Sample size", "Mean CAPS-5 score", "Standard deviation")

t <- prepare(task=task, S)
sol <- format_feedback(
  t$correct, t$explanations, t$praise, t$blame, t$extra
)
```

Question
========
In a clinical trial, patients diagnosed with post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD) 
were randomly assigned to Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (Therapy A) or Cognitive Behavioral Therapy 
combined with weekly Eye Movement Desensitization and Reprocessing (EMDR) sessions (Therapy B). 
PTSD symptom severity was assessed after treatment 
on the Clinician-Administered PTSD Scale for DSM-5 (CAPS-5), 
with higher scores indicating more severe symptoms.
Consider the following data:

````{r, echo=FALSE}
knitr::kable(tab, align=c("c", "c", "l"))
````

The pooled sample variance is $s^2_\mathrm{pool}$ = `r s2_pool`.
Assuming equal population variances, calculate the two-tailed $p$-value of the $t$-test 
for the difference between the group averages. 

```{r questionlist, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
answerlist(t$alternatives, markup="markdown")
```

Solution
========
The $p$-value is calculated by: `r t$solution`

```{r solutionlist, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
sol <- lapply(sol, FUN=gsub, pattern="\\n", replacement="")
answerlist(sol, markup="markdown")
```
